page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Data and API keys are stored only in this browser.
page.storageNote: Projects, nodes, conversations and images live in the browser's IndexedDB; clearing browser data wipes them too.

toast.stepsUnlimited: Saved: no step limit; you can stop generation manually at any time
toast.testOkNoTools: {{label}} connected, but no tool-calling capability was detected: chat will proceed without tools

context.budgetHint: Once exceeded, earlier parent-chain conversations are compressed automatically. Allowed range {{min}}–{{max}}; values beyond it are saved at the boundary.

prefs.dialogToggleTitle: Show quick-prompt dialog when creating a child node
prefs.dialogOn: When you select text and click "New child node", a dialog opens: pick a quick prompt or type your own, and you can check "Remember choice" there.
prefs.dialogOff: No more dialog: clicking "New child node" sends the remembered prompt below directly; selected text is still attached as a quote capsule.
prefs.rememberedHint: Checking "Remember choice" in the dialog saves the prompt you confirmed; click a chip to switch back to a quick prompt anytime.

agent.maxStepsHintA: Maximum number of tool calls the model can make in one turn (one step = one model call, including the final answer). Default 50;
agent.maxStepsHintB: (the model decides when to finish, and you can interrupt generation with the stop button at any time).

chat.label: Chat model
chat.hint: Used for question-and-answer inside a node.

title.label: Title model
title.hint: Leave empty to use the question text as the title.

summary.label: Summary model
summary.hint: Used to generate node study summaries manually; leave empty to disable the feature.

providers.empty: No providers yet. Add one, fill in the API key and model IDs, and you can start chatting.

picker.empty: No available models yet — add one in Settings first.

reasoning.inputPlaceholder: Auto, or type a level (low / high / xhigh…)
reasoning.noModels: No models yet — enter a model ID first
reasoning.noLevels: No reasoning levels recognized in the model catalog (or the model doesn't support them); type your own above

dialog.keyNote: API keys are stored only in this browser and never uploaded.
dialog.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for the official default address; OpenAI-compatible setups can point to a self-hosted proxy.
dialog.modelsHint: Fetch the model list from upstream or enter IDs manually; "Smart match" pulls the online config and shows capability tags.
dialog.modelInputPlaceholder: Enter a model ID, e.g. deepseek-chat or gpt-5.1…
dialog.suggestionsHeader_one: Matched {{count}} upstream model (click or press Enter to add):
dialog.suggestionsHeader_other: Matched {{count}} upstream models (click or press Enter to add):
dialog.fetchTitle: Fetch the available model list from the upstream API
dialog.notInCatalog: Not found in the online catalog
dialog.capabilitiesHeader: Capability toggles and context (from the online match or manual overrides):
dialog.fullManual: Not found in the online catalog — fully manual config
dialog.levelsHeader: Reasoning levels (leave empty to follow the general/online default; custom values allowed, comma-separated):
dialog.presetThreeTitle: Fill in the standard three levels: low, medium, high
dialog.presetFourTitle: Fill in four levels: low, medium, high, xhigh
dialog.presetTwoTitle: Fill in two levels: low, high
dialog.presetToggleTitle: Fill in a single level: none (toggle only)
dialog.levelsPlaceholder: e.g. low, medium, high (or use the presets on the right)
dialog.noModels: No models yet. Type above and press Enter to add one.
dialog.matchNeedsModel: Add at least one model ID first
dialog.matchAll_one: All {{count}} model matched the online catalog
dialog.matchAll_other: All {{count}} models matched the online catalog
dialog.matchPartial_one: {{count}}/{{total}} model matched; unmatched ones still work
dialog.matchPartial_other: {{count}}/{{total}} models matched; unmatched ones still work
dialog.matchNone: No match found in the online catalog; it can still be used
dialog.fetchEmpty: The upstream API responded but returned no usable models
